## Summary

Describe the physical-keyboard behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run audit`
- [ ] `./doctor.command --non-interactive` when local install behavior is affected
- [ ] Physical shortcut smoke test, or an explicit note explaining why it was not run
- [ ] Documentation and shortcut matrix updated when behavior changed

## Safety

- [ ] Rules remain scoped to explicitly enrolled keyboards
- [ ] No live Karabiner configuration, personal paths, email addresses, logs, or app-specific private settings are included
